The '''Great Rim Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] within the [[Hapan Rim Worlds]], the [[Corsair Outback]],<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Rifle Worlds]] of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].<ref name="TEA" /> It started at the [[Rynmar system/Legends|Rynmar system]] then went through the [[Zalori system/Legends|Zalori system]], the [[Terephon system/Legends|Terephon system]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Reboam system/Legends|Reboam system]], the [[Dreena system/Legends|Dreena system]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Calfa system/Legends|Calfa system]], and the [[K'Farri system/Legends|K'Farri system]].<ref name="TEA" /> From the K'Farri system it continued through the [[Nantuker system/Legends|Nantuker system]], the [[Stalsinek system/Legends|Stalsinek system]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Jodaka system/Legends|Jodaka system]], and the [[Divora system/Legends|Divora system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The hyperspace lane finally ended after going through the [[Wodan system/Legends|Wodan system]], a junction off to the [[Algnadesh system/Legends|Algnadesh system]]<ref name="TEA" /> and one last jump to the [[Relephon system/Legends|Relephon system]].
